project_info.color_palette: Purple, pink, white, soft blue, pastel floral accents

main_subject.detail: A premium award-announcement product card. On the left is a geometric trophy block labeled '2026 WORLD DAIRY INNOVATION AWARDS WINNER' on a base reading 'Best Children's Dairy Product', 'VIETNAM DAIRY PRODUCTS JOINT STOCK COMPANY', and 'Optimum A2 Pro+'. On the right are four Optimum A2 Pro+ product cartons. Large white headline text says 'Optimum A2 Pro+ Đạt giải thưởng Sữa tốt nhất dành cho trẻ em*'. Small footer text explains the award belongs to World Dairy Innovation Awards 2026.

Include the exact headline 'Optimum A2 Pro+ Đạt giải thưởng Sữa tốt nhất dành cho trẻ em*', the base text 'Best Children's Dairy Product', 'VIETNAM DAIRY PRODUCTS JOINT STOCK COMPANY', 'Optimum A2 Pro+', and the footer note '(*) Là giải thưởng “Best Children’s Dairy Product” (Sữa tốt nhất dành cho trẻ em) thuộc khuôn khổ World Dairy Innovation Awards 2026'. Technical style: photoreal premium product advertising composite, soft premium retail-display lighting, pastel bokeh glow and crisp product readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
